ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your claim is upheld in part, and SGD 7.65 of the SGD 39.06 you were charged is returned to you. To the driver: the charge stands for the distance actually and lawfully driven, but not for the excess. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04).

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. POL-RD-01 requires the threshold test to be run on the GPS trace, not the rounded trip-record copy: EV-GPS-02834 measures 30.94 km of polyline between the recorded pickup and dropoff events, and the booked optimal on EV-TRIP-02834 is 23.8 km, so the excess is 7.14 km. That is 30.0% of optimal, clearing the 20% limb, and it clears the 0.8 km absolute limb, so both establishment tests pass and a route deviation is established on this trip's own evidence. It is NOT a material deviation: 7.14 km is below the 8.0 km mark and 30.0% is below the 50% mark, so POL-RD-06 is never engaged, no repeat-pattern finding is made, and no driver-conduct referral arises. The trace is clean for policy purposes as well as for the pre-pass — 243 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s — so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) do not fire and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

BURDEN. The rider discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden: EV-TRIP-02834, EV-GPS-02834 and EV-FARE-02834 all carry trip TRP-02834, the trace's first fix at 10:10:16 matches the recorded start, and the excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The driver's only answer, 'Followed navigation', cites no artifact and no clause and does not discharge the shifted burden. There is also no traffic advisory to run: EV-ADVIS-02834-01 is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 (its issue is MISSING_ARTIFACT — no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window), so POL-RD-03 has nothing behind it and the driver's general assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. This is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation: no exculpatory clause was invoked against a cited artifact by the party relying on it, and the absence of an advisory nobody relied on is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it — precisely the situation POL-RD-13 addresses.

NO EXONERATION. The chat log EV-CHAT-02834 carries 0 messages, so no rider instruction under POL-RD-04 exists and no waypoint_hint is available to corroborate one. EV-TRIP-02834 shows original_pickup and original_dropoff null, both amendment timestamps null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 has no re-quote to run and the booked optimal of 23.8 km stands.

THE REFUND IS ARITHMETIC. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs. The surge multiplier is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02834 and is 1.0. Recomputed fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 23.8 km = 17.85 + 0.28 x 32.1 min = 8.988) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP/tolls + 0.00 fixed surcharges + 0.00 waiting time - 0.00 promo = 31.4380. Charged total = 39.06. Refund = 39.06 - 31.4380 = 7.6220, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 7.65. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and 19.5% of the charged total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: EV-FARE-02834 carries zero ERP lines (off-route total 0.00, on-route total 0.00) and no airport surcharge, so there is no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity referral. The driver is owed no compensation either: the rider was billed 30.9 km against a trace of 30.94 km, a shortfall of 0.04 km, far below the 1.0 km that POL-RD-04's compensation limb requires.

The rider's claim text ('30.94 km for 23.8 km, $39.06') describes the excess correctly, but the amount returned is the arithmetic figure of 7.65, not a round estimate, and it is taken from the fare breakdown's refund computation. The driver's advocate is right that the excess is real and the refund is the POL-RD-02 figure, and that concession is accepted.

DISCARDED EVIDENCE. Two claims about the missing advisory were discarded at the mechanical citation check because each cited EV-ADVIS-02834-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) without disclosing the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Nothing in this ruling rests on that artifact.

EXECUTION. The monetary effect is SGD 7.65, which does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue. Confidence is 0.9: every fact this ruling rests on is carried by an artifact at weight_multiplier 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
